+ #!/usr/bin/env python3
+ """
+ Test script to verify classification labels are properly handled as one-hot encoding
+ """
+ 
+ import sys
+ import os
+ sys.path.append('yolov5c')
+ 
+ from utils.dataloaders import create_dataloader
+ import torch
+ 
+ def test_classification_labels():
+     """Test classification label processing"""
+     print("=== 分類標籤 One-Hot 編碼測試 ===")
+     
+     # Load dataset
+     data_yaml = 'Regurgitation-YOLODataset-Detection/data.yaml'
+     batch_size = 4
+     
+     try:
+         # Create dataloader
+         train_loader, dataset = create_dataloader(
+             path=data_yaml,
+             imgsz=640,
+             batch_size=batch_size,
+             stride=32,
+             hyp=None,
+             augment=False,
+             cache=False,
+             rect=False,
+             rank=-1,
+             workers=0,
+             image_weights=False,
+             quad=False,
+             prefix='test: ',
+             shuffle=False
+         )
+         
+         print(f"Dataset loaded successfully")
+         print(f"Dataset size: {len(dataset)}")
+         print(f"Number of classes: {dataset.nc}")
+         print(f"Classification classes: {dataset.num_classes if hasattr(dataset, 'num_classes') else 'Unknown'}")
+         
+         # Test first batch
+         print("\n=== 測試第一個批次 ===")
+         for batch_idx, (imgs, labels, classification_labels, paths, shapes) in enumerate(train_loader):
+             print(f"Batch {batch_idx}:")
+             print(f"  Images shape: {imgs.shape}")
+             print(f"  Detection labels shape: {labels.shape}")
+             print(f"  Classification labels shape: {classification_labels.shape}")
+             print(f"  Classification labels dtype: {classification_labels.dtype}")
+             
+             # Check classification labels format
+             print(f"  Classification labels content:")
+             for i in range(min(3, len(classification_labels))):
+                 cls_label = classification_labels[i]
+                 print(f"    Sample {i}: {cls_label.tolist()}")
+                 
+                 # Verify one-hot format
+                 if torch.sum(cls_label) == 1.0 and torch.max(cls_label) == 1.0:
+                     class_idx = torch.argmax(cls_label).item()
+                     print(f"      -> One-hot valid: class {class_idx}")
+                 else:
+                     print(f"      -> WARNING: Not valid one-hot encoding!")
+             
+             # Check if all labels sum to 1.0 (valid one-hot)
+             valid_one_hot = torch.all(torch.sum(classification_labels, dim=1) == 1.0)
+             print(f"  All labels valid one-hot: {valid_one_hot}")
+             
+             break  # Only test first batch
+             
+     except Exception as e:
+         print(f"Error loading dataset: {e}")
+         import traceback
+         traceback.print_exc()
+         return False
+     
+     return True
+

+                     line = line.strip()

+                         elif len(parts) == 3:

+                         else:

+         else:
